notes.subject: feat(sdk): condense mid-turn and estimate the CLI request envelope like the condenser
notes.summary: The CLI and Assistant now condense long conversations mid-turn and estimate request size like VS Code (about four characters per token), so they condense near VS Code's threshold instead of failing early.
